stories.title: Could a law change 'complete' Daniel O'Connell's legacy?
stories.summary: Legislation still exists that bars Roman Catholics from exercising the responsibility of presenting the monarch with a candidate to head the Church of England.

stories.title: New contract will make it 'easier' to get GP appointments
stories.summary: The Department of Health (DoH) said it will give an additional £40m across two years for "improvements in patient access and primary care activity".

stories.title: Yellow fog warning for Northern Ireland
stories.summary: The warning runs from 22:00 GMT on Sunday until 10:00 on Monday, with inland areas expected to be most affected.

stories.title: Derry City 'til I die' says fan after victory in final
stories.summary: On Sunday, thousands of Candystripes supporters cheered on their team in the FAI Cup Final at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin.

stories.title: Paramedic sustains multiple injuries in hospital assault
stories.summary: The NI Ambulance Service said the paramedic sustained injuries to the back of her head, neck, face, and hands during the incident.

stories.title: First Derry goal worth the wait for final hero Burns
stories.summary: Derry City's FAI Cup final hero Darragh Burns says there is "nowhere better" to get his first goal for the club than scoring the winner at the Aviva Stadium in the decider.

stories.title: Not planning for a united Ireland is not 'sustainable', says tánaiste
stories.summary: Simon Harris was speaking at his party's ard fheis, where the Fine Gael "blueprint" on Irish unity was published.

stories.title: Policing remains a touchy subject in Northern Ireland
stories.summary: As the Police Service of Northern Ireland marks its 25th anniversary, the BBC's Mark Simpson tries to get the views of the public it serves.

stories.title: 'People have been knitting and crocheting for the past year' - cascading poppies for Remembrance
stories.summary: Towns and villages have been marking the sacrifice of those who died in war ahead of Remembrance Sunday.

stories.title: The woman capturing the beauty of the skies on camera
stories.summary: Rachel Cassidy's picture - A Midsummer Night’s Dream - captures a display of noctilucent clouds.

stories.title: 'You feel that you're not alone' - the young people finding community in grief
stories.summary: Too Young to Grieve is an informal peer support community providing young people with a space to grieve.

stories.title: Turtle returns to sea after 22 years recovering in Irish aquarium
